design_objective: Develop a guided B601 full-range dress-pack candidate that first proves the eight continuous mission trajectory segments while preserving the accepted robot and Solar R2 assets.

parent-child link semi-captive moving guide or rolling loop
trade local side-bypass against guided rolling loop

Route-B local positive result is a design seed only

required_product_inputs: frozen conductor and connector map with current, data-rate and shielding needs
measured or supplier-controlled finished bundle OD and tolerance
minimum static and dynamic bend radius by selected cable construction and temperature
linear mass and component mass with uncertainty and provenance
torsional and bending restoring-load curves versus angle, rate and temperature
guide, clamp, liner and fastener material/process selections
abrasion, particulate, outgassing, thermal-vacuum and flex-life limits
installation inspection and post-install electrical test procedure

analysis_contract.coordinate_authority: accepted URDF link/joint frames; geometry additions must be separately versioned and must not edit the accepted URDF
analysis_contract.first_release_domain: the eight authority-tagged continuous mission trajectory segments
analysis_contract.full_hardware_range: evaluate only if the Owner requires it after mission-first closure
coupled_predicate: guide/carrier kinematic closure and hard-stop margin
Solar R2 keep-out and deployment-interlock compatibility
analysis_contract.fail_closed_rule: Any absent authority, missing product datum, unproved trajectory segment, UNKNOWN predicate, or hash mismatch yields HOLD/UNKNOWN; it never yields PASS.
analysis_contract.uncertainty_rule: Every physical input shall retain estimate, unit, standard uncertainty or bounded distribution, provenance and correlation notes; rejected Route-B mass is not an uncertainty prior.

required: independently issued Owner authorization referencing the ODR-42 request hash
minimum product/interface inputs: measured or controlled bundle OD, applicable bend limit, conductor/connector definition, installation interfaces and life target
abrasion/TVAC/flex-life and post-install electrical verification plan
consumer runtime rebind and negative controls

first_pass_closure_sequence.name: authorization
first_pass_closure_sequence.exit: independent Owner decision references request hash

first_pass_closure_sequence.name: electrical and mechanical input freeze
first_pass_closure_sequence.exit: minimum C2-start inputs frozen, while remaining qualification-grade inputs continue on the downstream register

first_pass_closure_sequence.name: STEP-first parametric design

first_pass_closure_sequence.exit: reproducible separate source and STEP with named datums constraints and reviewed snapshots

first_pass_closure_sequence.name: eight continuous mission trajectories
first_pass_closure_sequence.entry: C2 candidate loadable and trajectory definitions controlled
first_pass_closure_sequence.exit: 8/8 released continuous trajectories with auditable timing sampling and hashes

first_pass_closure_sequence.name: exact coupled verification
first_pass_closure_sequence.entry: C2 and C3 complete with nonempty comparison sets
first_pass_closure_sequence.exit: all mission-domain samples SAFE; full hardware range also SAFE only when that range is claimed
first_pass_closure_sequence.fail_closed_rollback: return C2/C3 on any UNKNOWN or UNSAFE

first_pass_closure_sequence.name: mass CG inertia and restoring torque
first_pass_closure_sequence.entry: controlled product data geometry and motion domain
first_pass_closure_sequence.exit: nine-configuration mass properties and joint loads carry units uncertainty provenance and meet budgets
first_pass_closure_sequence.fail_closed_rollback: return C1/C2; do not update dynamics SSOT

first_pass_closure_sequence.name: abrasion TVAC and life plan
first_pass_closure_sequence.entry: materials process motion and load domains controlled
first_pass_closure_sequence.exit: approved article environment cycle inspection electrical-test and acceptance plan

first_pass_closure_sequence.name: handoff and consumer rebind
first_pass_closure_sequence.entry: C4-C6 evidence and independent review complete
first_pass_closure_sequence.exit: current hashes bound and runtime harness negative controls deny UNKNOWN/UNSAFE
first_pass_closure_sequence.fail_closed_rollback: ABORT or diagnostic-only; no production dynamics or physical-contact RL
